title: clitoria guianensis
intro: Clitoria guianensis, commonly known as Butterfly Pea, is a flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulator, which helps to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Clitoria guianensis include its potential to reduce anxiety and depression, improve sleep quality, and support cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and antioxidant activities.
